en: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “The Lily of the Covenant.” A teaching poem by David, when he fought with Aram Naharaim and with Aram Zobah, and Joab returned, and killed twelve thousand of Edom in the Valley of Salt.

zh: 大衛與兩河間的亞蘭並瑣巴的亞蘭爭戰的時候，約押轉回，在鹽谷攻擊以東，殺了一萬二千人。那時，大衛作這金詩，叫人學習，交與伶長。調用為證的百合花。

ja: 指揮者のために。「契約のゆり」に合わせて。ダビデによる教訓の詩。彼がアラム・ナハライムおよびアラム・ツォバと戦い、ヨアブが帰って来て、塩の谷でエドム人一万二千人を打ち殺したとき。

p.src: 1  God, you have rejected us. You have broken us down. You have been angry. Restore us, again.

ja: ち壊された。 あなたは
っておられた。 もう一度、
たちを立ち直らせてください。
en: God, you have rejected us. You have broken us down. You have been angry. Restore us, again.
u.src: 1  God, you have rejected us. You have broken us down. You have been angry. Restore us, again.

p.src: 2  You have made the land tremble. You have torn it. Mend its fractures, for it quakes.

en: You have made the land tremble. You have torn it. Mend its fractures, for it quakes.
u.src: 2  You have made the land tremble. You have torn it. Mend its fractures, for it quakes.

p.src: 3  You have shown your people hard things. You have made us drink the wine that makes us stagger.

ja: たちによろめきのぶどう
en: You have shown your people hard things. You have made us drink the wine that makes us stagger.
u.src: 3  You have shown your people hard things. You have made us drink the wine that makes us stagger.

p.src: 4  You have given a banner to those who fear you, that it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah.

ja: げられるように。 セラ。
en: You have given a banner to those who fear you, that it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah.
u.src: 4  You have given a banner to those who fear you, that it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah.

p.src: 5  So that your beloved may be delivered, save with your right hand, and answer us.

ja: されるように、 あなたの
en: So that your beloved may be delivered, save with your right hand, and answer us.
u.src: 5  So that your beloved may be delivered, save with your right hand, and answer us.

p.src: 6  God has spoken from his sanctuary: “I will triumph. I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.

ja: は勝ち誇る。 シェケムを
en: God has spoken from his sanctuary: “I will triumph. I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.
u.src: 6  God has spoken from his sanctuary: “I will triumph. I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.

p.src: 7  Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine. Ephraim also is the defense of my head. Judah is my scepter.

ja: のもの。 エフライムは
en: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine. Ephraim also is the defense of my head. Judah is my scepter.
u.src: 7  Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine. Ephraim also is the defense of my head. Judah is my scepter.

p.src: 8  Moab is my wash basin. I will throw my sandal on Edom. I shout in triumph over Philistia.”

en: Moab is my wash basin. I will throw my sandal on Edom. I shout in triumph over Philistia.”
u.src: 8  Moab is my wash basin. I will throw my sandal on Edom. I shout in triumph over Philistia.”

p.src: 9  Who will bring me into the strong city? Who has led me to Edom?

ja: に連れて行くだろうか。 誰が私をエドムへ
en: Who will bring me into the strong city? Who has led me to Edom?
u.src: 9  Who will bring me into the strong city? Who has led me to Edom?

p.src: 10  Haven’t you, God, rejected us? You don’t go out with our armies, God.

ja: けられたのではないか。
en: Haven’t you, God, rejected us? You don’t go out with our armies, God.
u.src: 10  Haven’t you, God, rejected us? You don’t go out with our armies, God.

p.src: 11  Give us help against the adversary, for the help of man is vain.

ja: 敵に立ち向かうため、私たちに
en: Give us help against the adversary, for the help of man is vain.
u.src: 11  Give us help against the adversary, for the help of man is vain.

p.src: 12  Through God we will do valiantly, for it is he who will tread down our adversaries.

ja: ましく行動する。 私たちの
en: Through God we will do valiantly, for it is he who will tread down our adversaries.
u.src: 12  Through God we will do valiantly, for it is he who will tread down our adversaries.
